inspiration.observed_pattern: A recursive CTE carries a parent-derived value through UNION ALL while its anchor selects the same source column twice under the CTE column list.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reduced to a three-node hierarchy whose recursive anchor selects one node ID twice without projection aliases, making positional preservation of duplicate result names observable.

fixture_notes: The root ID must remain 1 for every descendant even though the anchor selects the root node ID twice and relies on the CTE column list to name the positions.
determinism_notes: Three fixed nodes, parent links, CTE column names, and explicit output ordering are used. No clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE mini_units (unit_id INT PRIMARY KEY, parent_id INT NULL)

steps.sql: WITH RECURSIVE unit_tree (root_id, unit_id) AS (SELECT unit_id, unit_id FROM mini_units WHERE parent_id IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT parent.root_id, child.unit_id FROM unit_tree AS parent INNER JOIN mini_units AS child ON child.parent_id = parent.unit_id) SELECT root_id, unit_id FROM unit_tree ORDER BY root_id, unit_id
